text_block_list.text: One day after training, while I was tidying up—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Ah!! Excuse me, <username>-trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —So, as I was saying, we invited Saint Light-san, Speed Symboli-san, and Haiseiko-san to the academy today, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Of all blunders, I completely forgot to hand over some of the documents to them...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: They seem to still be on academy grounds... I hate to ask, but could you please deliver this to one of them?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I will hand the documents to the other two myself! Please, I'm counting on you~!
Saint Light was—on the rooftop. Even after receiving the documents, she lingered for a while, leisurely gazing out over the scenery...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
—It has not changed at all.
This place.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
The scent of the soil. The fragrance of the breeze.
They still—remain unchanged.

Her expression is tranquil.
I had heard that during her active days, she was just like this whenever she wasn't racing, but—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed. I spent my time quite leisurely. Often—right here.
choice_data_list: There are still kids who... take it easy here even now.

text_block_list.text: I casually mention that to Saint Light. Come to think of it, even now, the rooftop seems to attract free spirits and solitary types—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
That's lovely!
My, oh my.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Even now—such children gather here?
Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Yet, rather unexpectedly.
From among them—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Is born.
The next legend.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —I see, thank you for the documents! Did you have trouble tracking me down? My apologies.
choice_data_list: Not at all! ...Were you looking for Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No. I simply felt like stopping by.
—It brought back memories of my school days, you see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Though back then, unlike Rudolf, I never served as president or on the student council.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I was somewhat of a daydreamer, so I left all of that entirely to someone better suited for it!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Even so, we gathered here often. And with my companions... we talked endlessly.
choice_data_list: It really is a place full of memories, then.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah. Right—yes, right there. That sofa was my designated spot.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Right, I remember one day I even brought in a guitar and sang at the top of my lungs with my friends!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Fufu, naturally, the student council president of that era gave me quite an earful.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: A guitar, huh... I still have it, but—the strings must have stretched completely loose by now.
Now then, where should I look...? As I ponder, one specific place immediately comes to mind.
Haiseiko was a top-tier idol horse girl since her school days. If she's anywhere around here—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Wah, a delivery! You went out of your way to look for me—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Wait, or perhaps it wasn't that hard? Was the place I'd be at just that obvious?
choice_data_list: Well, yes, I figured you'd be here...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! ...My friends back in my school days used to tell me that all the time too. "If you're looking for Haa-chan, check here first!" they'd say.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: It's changed just a little bit since then, though—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: The mirrors got super-duper huuuuge! And the floor is squeeeaky clean now!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yet the flutter in my heart hasn't changed at all♪ When I close my eyes right here, I can see it.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Always warmly welcoming me—the wonderful fans and that dazzling stage!
